turns.reply:
I solved level 2 in 22 actions. The human baseline is 33 and the cap was 165.

**How the game works:**
- Each ball sits at the average position of its chain's ends. With two ends it is the midpoint. With three ends it is the average of all three.
- One end is free (colour 0). The other ends are fixed (colour 3). Clicking a fixed end makes it the free end, and that click costs one action.
- Clicking an empty cell moves the free end there. The ends may sit on colour a.
- A move is rejected if the ball would overlap colour a. You see a long animation, nothing moves, and the action still counts.
- You win when every ball is on the diamond of its own colour.

**This level:** First I moved the c-ball down through the gap near x=41 to its target at (40,51). Then I moved the f-ball up and to the right to its target near (57,18). The level ended one click earlier than I planned. The ball was still about 5 cells left of the target centre, so I think it only needs to be close. I have not tested how close.

About 7 actions were wasted: 5 moves rejected by the colour a rule, and 2 test clicks at the start. I saved these rules in the global memory for this game, so later levels can avoid those mistakes.

{"action": "finish"}

steps.text: The ball at (52,18) ended up landing in the target region, so the level completed successfully despite my uncertainty. I should update my memory with what I learned from this outcome.
